## CGEI unit change

**Unit id / code:**  
**Tier:** Core / Support  
**Readiness after merge:** draft / review / validated  

### Checklist

- [ ] Lessons have substantive blocks (prose + worked example + cautions as needed)
- [ ] ≥ 3 questions per touched lesson; ≥ 2 cognitive levels; ≥ 1 apply-or-higher
- [ ] Fixture covers quoted numbers (`unit_*_check.py`)
- [ ] Traceability rows updated with honest dispositions
- [ ] Audit note (P0–P3) attached or linked
- [ ] `npm run check:cgei` and `npm run lint:cgei-questions` pass on this head
- [ ] No readiness promotion without recorded scientific review

See `docs/cgei/UNIT_PR_CHECKLIST.md`.
